resources.string: Timetable, homework and marks from your school\'s electronic diary
The same login and password as on your electronic diary\'s website

The password goes straight to the diary, over HTTPS, and nowhere else: not to our server and not to this phone\'s storage. The server is handed only the session the diary issued. When that ends, the app will ask for the password again.
The diary closed the session for %1$s. The login is still known - only the password is needed.
This diary sign-in is no longer valid. Please sign in again.
The diary is not answering. Try again later.
The diary answered in a way the server could not read: the service changed, and that is fixed on the server rather than in the app.
No connection to the server. Check the network and the server address under “Sync”.
No connection to the server. Check the network and the server address.
That date range is too wide - the diary serves at most 62 days at a time.
This account has no such pupil.
You are signed in to the diary as %1$s.
The diary returned no children for this login. Check that this is the right account.
The diary returned no lessons for these seven days. Step through the weeks with the arrows.
Nothing has been entered in the register for this period.
The class, its timetable and its notifications stay where they are: these are two separate accounts. Coming back to the diary needs the login and password again.
A correction changes only what you see here. Nothing changes in the diary itself, and the teacher will not see it.
The diary now says something else — see whether the correction is still wanted
There are two such lessons that day and the diary does not tell them apart. The correction is not applied — it can only be reset.
Tap a lesson or a task to correct it

⚠️ The server address starts with http://. That does not touch the password - it goes straight to the diary over HTTPS. But the session the diary issues, and the key to it, travel to the server in the clear: anyone on the same Wi-Fi can pick them up and open your diary. Set up https:// on the server if you can.
The password goes only to %1$s - over HTTPS, straight to the diary.
In this region the diary lets people in through Gosuslugi only. The app does not sign in there - open the diary\'s website in a browser.
%1$s is not answering. Try again later.
%1$s is refusing this phone. If a VPN is on, turn it off and try again.
The diary is refusing this phone. If a VPN is on, turn it off and try again.
This phone does not trust the certificate of %1$s, and the app will not work around that check.
This phone does not trust the diary\'s certificate, and the app will not work around that check.
%1$s answered in a way the app cannot read - most likely its sign-in page changed. An app update fixes that, not another password.
Cannot reach the diary. Check the network.
%1$s did not answer in time. Try again.
No answer came in time. Try again.
The diary let you in, but the server cannot be reached right now. Try again - no need to type the password.
No server address is set. Set one under “Sync”.
No server address is set, and signing in needs one.
This server cannot take a sign-in opened on the phone. It needs a newer server, or another address.
The diary is switched off on this server. Only whoever runs the server can switch it on.
This server does not work with your region\'s diary.
The diary let you in, but refused the sign-in from the server\'s address. It is not the password, and trying again will not help. You can join a class by its code instead.
The diary let you in, but refused the sign-in from the server\'s address. It is not the password, and trying again will not help.
The diary is not answering the server: it refuses requests from its address. It is not the password.
The diary shows no pupil for this account.
Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.

If an administrator sets up your school\'s class in the bot, its code adds the class timetable, the widget and the bell reminders.
Enter the class code the administrator gave you in the bot. The diary stays: it moves to Settings → Diary.

plurals.name: diary_sign_out_home
plurals.item: The phone goes back to the start. Lessons and marks saved on the phone are deleted, and the server deletes its copy of the sign-in. If the phone is offline right now, the server deletes it by itself %1$d day after the diary was last used, and keeps a Setevoy Gorod session open until then.

The phone goes back to the start. Lessons and marks saved on the phone are deleted, and the server deletes its copy of the sign-in. If the phone is offline right now, the server deletes it by itself %1$d days after the diary was last used, and keeps a Setevoy Gorod session open until then.

Type at least two characters and the region\'s diary will list matching schools.
